item.title: Gaurav-Gosain/tuios
item.description: A terminal window manager that knows what your agents are doing. Tiling panes, workspaces, sessions that survive restarts, and one Inbox for every coding agent. Official only at tuios.dev and this repo. tuios has no X/Twitter account.

item.title: clusterzx/paperless-ai
item.description: AI companion for Paperless-ngx OR it's own document managment system: automatically titles, tags and files your documents, reads bad scans with local OCR (PaddleOCR, CPU/GPU) and answers questions about your whole archive with cited sources. Works with OpenAI, Claude, Ollama (fully local), Azure and any OpenAI-compatible API.

item.title: fallow-rs/fallow
item.description: Codebase intelligence for TypeScript and JavaScript. Health, complexity hotspots, duplication, architecture boundaries, circular dependencies, design-system drift, and unused code, from one graph. CLI, GitHub Action, LSP, MCP, and VS Code. Rust, MIT licensed.

item.title: mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills

Plain markdown, MIT, in Anthropic's plugin directory. Free in-browser or npx pm-claude-skills add.
